clues: This town is the seat of its county, and the most old town of its state. It stands on the river that runs by its south side.
Half of this town's year rain falls from June to September. Summers bring oft, short, fierce storms in the hot wet air.
This town was set up in 1733 on its river. It was the chief town of its colony, and then the first chief town of its state.
Each year this town draws crowds in the millions to its stone-paved lanes. The girl who set up the Girl Scouts was born here.
Its old heart holds one of the most big marked old zones of the land. Two and twenty green squares sit like parks in its grid.
